boundary_basis: 1000 indexed pointers terminate immediately at the independently consumed speaker table EC7944. Every pointer leads to a distinct valid opcode31-terminated stream. This is stored-resource coverage, not proof every index is called in play.

consumer_guards.role: script index -> table pointer -> context initializer -> VM
initializer stores script pointer at context+10
VM loads context+10 and dispatches low halfword
handler passes record to dialogue consumer
label lookup scans the same 8-byte stream until opcode31
next adjacent table is speaker records, separate consumer
Opcode25 wrapper receives the same full dialogue record
Unknown-speaker presentation wrapper calls original C7550 dialogue consumer
